name: Tintina Mines Limited
summary: Tintina Mines Limited engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of base and precious metal properties in Canada and Chile. It also explores for gold, copper, molybdenum, and silver deposits. The company holds interest in various properties located in the Whitehorse Mining District, Yukon Territory; Sudbury Mining District, Ontario; Watson Lake Mining District, Yukon Territory; and the Dos Amigos mining district, Chile. Tintina Mines Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
